display_long_description:
VR BATTLEGROUNDS delivers immersive tactical VR combat across four modes: Team Deathmatch (TDM), Story Mode, Rage Room, and an offline "feels-like-online" multiplayer. Realistic, high-fidelity maps, responsive VR gunplay, and customizable loadouts create cinematic, replayable encounters.

Story Mode — Chapter 1: Bank Heist
A downtown bank is under siege. Robbers hold staff captive and lock the vault. Your mission: breach, neutralize hostiles, and rescue every worker. Use cover, tactical breaching, and environmental interactions to clear each area — expect tense close-quarters combat and emergent encounters that reward strategy.
[media]

TDM & Multiplayer
Jump into fast TDM across varied realistic arenas. Our offline multiplayer emulation adapts AI to skill, delivering competitive matches without servers — perfect for travel or private sessions.
[media]
[media]

Rage Room & Progression
Unload in Rage Room, unlock weapons, skins, and attachments, and tune loadouts for assault, stealth, or long-range play.
[media]

Built and optimized for Quest performance with regular updates. Note: multiplayer is offline but engineered to feel like live play. Strap in and dominate the battlefield.

Why you’ll love it
• Realistic maps with dynamic encounters for intense immersion.
• Tight VR shooter controls, optimized for Quest performance.
• Story-driven missions (start with the bank heist) plus quick TDM rounds.
• Offline multiplayer that behaves like online play — great for travel and private sessions.
